section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Brazilian Figure Rating Scale (FRS) developed and validated by Kakeshita (2008) for children aged 7–12. The scale presents 11 male and 11 female silhouettes mapped to BMI values ranging from 12 to 29 kg/m2; participants indicate their current and desired silhouette, and scores are computed as Current BMI – Real BMI (perceptual accuracy) and Desired BMI – Current BMI (dissatisfaction).
section_summary.evidence_source: "This instrument was made and validated for Brazilian children aged 7 to 12 years old by Kakeshita (2008)."; "It consists of 11 silhouettes of each sex... from leaner (Body Mass Index [BMI] = 12 kg/m2) to the widest (BMI = 29 kg/m2)."; "The value of the estimation of body image is obtained by the operation Current BMI – Real BMI... The overall rate of dissatisfaction is provided by the operation Desired BMI - Current BMI..."
